messages:
alex: Quick heads-up — planning to ramp down the speculative-decode prefetch canary tomorrow 10:00 PST. Need ops sign-off and a final check on flash-attn fallback and KV-cache TTL. Who's available to validate audience + rollback guardrails?

priya: I'm around. Can you paste the cohort/audience config and the exact flag keys? want to check dedicated tags.

alex: sure — flag key: runtime.specdecode.prefetch.v2
config:
```
cohort: beta
percent: 1
regions: [us-west-2]
tags: [dedicated:true, env:prod]
```
also toggle plan: enable prefetch -> monitor 10m -> enable flash-attn fastpath for matching workloads -> rollback if error_rate > 5% or latency P90 regresses > 30ms

marta: ops looked at infra. dedicated pools have capacity. only ask: kv_cache.ttl bump from 6s->12s might increase backend load for cold keys. add per-host cache-miss logging.

sam: +1 on logs. I'll add a tiny metric: runtime.kv.cache_miss_rate and a perf guard in the rollout job. Also add `fallback_kernel=baseline` in canary so flash-attn fallback path is exercised.

lina: for rollback automation, suggest this check in the canary-runner:
```
if (errors_percent_last_3m > 5) || (p90_latency_delta > 30ms):
  toggle(runtime.specdecode.prefetch.v2, off)
  notify(#eng-oncall)
```
I'll open a PR for the runner.

deploy-bot: scheduled canary window for 2034507890-2034508200 by alex. link: https://deploys.internal/runs/2034507890

priya: FYI, code-review pinged @eng-runtime for the small change to tag audience. MR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/runtime/+/2345

alex: thanks all. action items: sam add metrics + log, lina PR for runner, priya verify tag inclusion, marta confirm infra capacity at 09:45 PST tomorrow. I'll flip the canary at 10:00 PST. :thumbsup:

marta: confirming infra check scheduled 09:45 PST. I'll post results here.

sam: will post metric dashboards before 09:55.

lina: PR opened: https://git.internal/r/redwood/ops/+/789

priya: reviewed audience MR, looks good. :eyes:

alex: great — locking in. if anything crops up tag me. thanks!
